title: Moving to Chicago; school with Ray Nance
summary: The family moved to Chicago in the 1920s; at Wendell Phillips High School he played in Ray Nance's band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And this is how I started. And my mother also at this time we left -- let's see, we left Montgomery, and we went to Chicago. This was around 1920 something, I was very small, you know. And I went to school in Chicago, and I went to school with Ray Nance. And -- who was a tremendous musician. We were in Wendell Wenda Philipps together. But Wendell Philipps High School. They had a very good band then. Nance had a very good band. I used to play with Nance's band, incidently.
